&\ge\mu(A'+B')+\mu(A''+B'')\cr
&\ge\bigl((\mu A')^{1/r}+(\mu B')^{1/r}\bigr)^r
  +\bigl((\mu A'')^{1/r}+(\mu B'')^{1/r}\bigr)^r\cr
&=\bigl((\gamma\mu A)^{1/r}+(\gamma\mu B)^{1/r}\bigr)^r
  +\bigl(((1-\gamma)\mu A)^{1/r}+((1-\gamma)\mu B)^{1/r}\bigr)^r\cr
&=(\bigl(\mu A)^{1/r}+(\mu B)^{1/r}\bigr)^r.\cr}
